Container.Name: Nextcloud-Redis
Container.Overview:
Redis cache and file-locking backend for Nextcloud.
This container provides Redis to be used by the "Nextcloud" template for distributed memcache (memcache.distributed) and file locking (memcache.locking). It does NOT expose a host port - it is reachable only by other containers on the "nextcloud-net" Docker network.
Setup: 1. Create the network: docker network create nextcloud-net 2. Generate a strong random password for Redis. Store it in your password manager. 3. Set REDIS_PASSWORD below. 4. Set the same value as REDIS_HOST_PASSWORD on the Nextcloud container.
Container.Requires: The user-defined Docker network "nextcloud-net" must already exist on the host: docker network create nextcloud-net

Config.Name: REDIS_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Strong random password for Redis. Must match REDIS_HOST_PASSWORD on the Nextcloud container.
